title: Unauthorized Access to Stored Government ID Images
description: The File System (DS4) may lack sufficient access controls, allowing unauthorized parties to access stored government ID images, leading to potential data breaches.
assumptions: Assumes DS4 does not enforce strict file permissions or encryption at rest.

title: Non-Compliance with Data Protection Regulations
description: The Authentication Service (P1) may store government ID images without ensuring compliance with legal requirements (e.g., GDPR), such as purpose limitation, data minimization, or retention policies.
assumptions: Assumes P1 does not validate legal basis or implement required safeguards before storing sensitive data.
